description: Core window permissions, plus autostart. This app grants the webview nothing beyond them — no filesystem, no shell, no arbitrary HTTP. Everything privileged goes through the commands in src/commands.rs, which are reachable by default and guard themselves: live_client_get checks the requested path against a fixed allowlist, and the device token is never returned across the boundary at all. Autostart is granted because the Settings toggle is a webview control and the plugin's whole surface is three calls that read or set one boolean about this app alone.
